correctness.rationale: For two collision-free unordered points on the graph realization, the deleted-product two-cubical model is valid after the two-particle subdivision criterion; its C0, C1, C2 signed S_m×S_n modules were identified from edge/vertex incidence and the signed square interchange. Farber–Hanbury Proposition 22 says K_mn is mature for m,n≥3; invariants of the particle swap imply H1≅U_m⊠U_n. Substituting P_r=1+U_r, A_r=1+U_r+V_r and B_r=U_r+W_r into [H2]=[C2]−[C1]+[C0]+[H1]−[H0] cancels all but V_m⊠W_n+W_m⊠V_n. Semisimplicity over Q converts the equality of characters to an isomorphism. Independent symbolic coefficient cancellation checked the general formal identity, not just finite dimensions; source finite cubical character checks cover small m,n as corroboration. The statement excludes three-vertex sides, integral splitting and sinks.

value.rationale: The natural two-sided symmetric automorphism group of all rectangular complete bipartite graphs acts on configuration-space homology. The multiplicity-free two-irreducible decomposition is a uniform nontrivial symmetry classification, stronger than rank or diagonal character; it supports further graph-braid and equivariant invariants.

final_claim: For every m,n≥4, the rational S_m×S_n-module H2(UConf_2(K_mn);Q) is S_m^(m−2,2)⊠S_n^(n−2,1,1) ⊕ S_m^(m−2,1,1)⊠S_n^(n−2,2), each irreducible summand once.
